sloka: अमात्यांस्तांस्तु सन्त्यज्य यमयोधा महाबलाः ।तमेव चाभ्यधावन्त शूलवर्षैर्दशाननम् ।। ७.२१.३३ ॥
transliteration: amātyāṁstāṁstu santyajya yamayodhā mahābalāḥ ।tameva cābhyadhāvanta śūlavarṣairdaśānanam ।। 7.21.33 ॥

translations.english: The mighty warriors of Yama, abandoning those ministers, rushed directly towards Dashanana (Ravana) with showers of spears.
